name: vivantel-kms
description: Eval harness tooling for plugins/kms/skills/** and plugins/kms/shared/** changes (docs/decisions/0043-eval-harness-for-shipped-skill-changes.md). This repo ships no npm package — it's a Claude Code plugin marketplace.

scripts.eval: for d in evals/*/; do [ -f "$d/promptfooconfig.yaml" ] || continue; echo "=== $d ==="; npx promptfoo eval -c "$d/promptfooconfig.yaml" "$@" || exit 1; done
